outcome_definition: Outcome = the number of distinct melting-curve classes the assay produced over the 36 oligodeoxynucleotide controls that enumerate every combination of the three C>T SNPs, and the number of controls left in a class with another control. A control in a shared class is NOT a genotype call. HRM-only rows use HRM data alone; HRM+PSQ rows are a COMBINED-CHEMISTRY result and are not HRM resolvability. Counts only - no rate is derived from them here.
